d:
Anirudh's spirited vocals resonates all through 'Damaalu Dumeelu' in Rokesh's local -slang style lyrics with high-octane beats by D.Imman, the highlight of the track being the symphony of powerful dialogues by distinguished villains and heroes of Tamil Cinema. Get set to go 'Damaalu Dumeelu'!
Watch the official Video here !
Song - Damaalu Dumeelu
Movie - Bogan
Singers - Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics - Rokesh
Music - D. Imman
Starring - Jayam Ravi, Arvind Swami, Hansika Motwani
